dedupe_keys.name: ruian czech register of territorial identification addresses and real estate

description: RÚIAN, the Register of Territorial Identification, Addresses and Real Estate, is one of the Czech Republic's basic public administration registers, kept by the Czech Office for Surveying, Mapping and Cadastre. It is a public list that holds no personal data and is the single authoritative source of addresses. It links territorial units from the state down to municipalities, cadastral areas and basic settlement units with streets, parcels, building objects (stavební objekty) and address places, including definition points and boundaries. Coverage: the whole Czech Republic; the public remote access application showed data valid at 26 September 2026. Access: public remote access (VDP) for searching and map display, and exchange format (VFR) XML files for the whole state or per municipality, as full copies or changes since a date, with address places also offered as CSV; monthly state files from August 2015 are archived for analysis, and files can be fetched through an Atom service or the E39 and E40 web services. Licence: ČÚZK conditions for spatial data, not read; free. Caveats: building objects carry the attributes the register keeps, not detailed structural data; the XSD schemas were updated on 8 July 2026 and senate electoral districts are added from 1 January 2027, so parsers need updating. Simulation uses are an authoritative building and address layer for exposure models, emergency dispatch geocoding and city digital twins. Related records: the Polish 3D building models and the Danish BBR register.
